69	class ThresholdSafe:
70	    def __init__(self, database: str, source: RandomSource | None = None):
71	        self.store = Store(database)
72	        self.source: RandomSource = source if source is not None else SystemRandomSource()
73	
74	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ create
75	    def create_secret(self, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
76	        spec = SecretSpec.parse(raw)
77	
78	        def create() -> dict[str, Any]:
79	            now = self.store.now()
80	            points = shamir.split(spec.secret, spec.threshold, len(spec.holders), self._source(spec.seed))
81	            mode = "separated" if spec.approvers is not None else "legacy"
82	            approvers = list(spec.approvers) if spec.approvers is not None else list(spec.holders)
83	            document = {
84	                "id": spec.id,
85	                "name": spec.name,
86	                "version": 1,
87	                "threshold": spec.threshold,
88	                "holders": list(spec.holders),
89	                "approvals_required": spec.approvals_required,
90	                "approval_mode": mode,
91	                "approvers": list(spec.approvers) if spec.approvers is not None else None,
92	                "versions": [{
93	                    "version": 1,
94	                    "approval_mode": mode,
95	                    "holders": list(spec.holders),
96	                    "approvers": approvers,
97	                }],
98	                "secret_digest": _secret_digest(spec.secret),
99	                "secret_length": len(spec.secret),
100	                "policy": spec.policy,
101	                "status": "active",
102	                "status_reason": None,
103	                "status_changed_at": now,
104	                "status_epoch": 0,
105	                "created_at": now,
106	                "updated_at": now,
107	            }
108	            try:
109	                self.store.connection.execute(
110	                    "INSERT INTO secrets(id, document, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
111	                    (spec.id, self.store.encode(document), now, now),
112	                )
113	            except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:
114	                if "UNIQUE constraint" not in str(error):
115	                    raise
116	                raise ConflictError(f"secret {spec.id} already exists") from error
117	            self._issue(1, spec.id, spec.holders, points)
118	            self._append(spec.id, "secret_created", {
119	                "version": 1,
120	                "name": spec.name,
121	                "threshold": spec.threshold,
122	                "approvals_required": spec.approvals_required,
123	                "approval_mode": mode,
124	                "approvers": approvers,
125	                "holders": list(spec.holders),
126	                "share_count": len(spec.holders),
127	                "secret_length": len(spec.secret),
128	                "deterministic": spec.seed is not None,
129	            })
130	            return self._record(spec.id)
131	
132	        return self._idempotent(key, f"create-secret:{spec.id}", create)
133	
134	    def get_secret(self, secret_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
135	        return self._record(secret_id)
136	
137	    def get_policy(self, secret_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
138	        """Return the persistent authorization policy of one secret.
139	
140	        Read-only: a frozen secret answers exactly like an active one, and no
141	        audit event or idempotency record is written. Secrets without a policy
142	        respond with ``{"policy": None}``.
143	        """
144	        return {"policy": self._document(secret_id).get("policy")}
145	
146	    # ------------------------------------------------------- freeze / unfreeze
147	    def freeze_secret(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
148	        self._require_key(key)
149	        reason = reason_field(raw)
150	
151	        def freeze_operation() -> str:
152	            document = self._document(secret_id)
153	            epoch = document["status_epoch"]
154	            # A completed freeze carries the epoch it entered; a pending freeze
155	            # while active would open the next epoch, so retries after an
156	            # unfreeze cannot replay an older freeze cycle's response.
157	            scope = epoch if document["status"] == "frozen" else epoch + 1
158	            return f"freeze-secret:{secret_id}:e{scope}"
159	
160	        def freeze() -> dict[str, Any]:
161	            document = self._document(secret_id)
162	            if document["status"] == "frozen":
163	                raise SecretFrozen(f"secret {secret_id} is already frozen")
164	            now = self.store.now()
165	            document["status"] = "frozen"
166	            document["status_reason"] = reason
167	            document["status_changed_at"] = now
168	            document["status_epoch"] = document["status_epoch"] + 1
169	            self.store.connection.execute(
170	                "UPDATE secrets SET document = ? WHERE id = ?",
171	                (self.store.encode(document), secret_id),
172	            )
173	            self._append(secret_id, "secret_frozen", {"version": document["version"], "reason": reason})
174	            return self._record(secret_id, document)
175	
176	        return self._idempotent(key, freeze_operation, freeze)
177	
178	    def unfreeze_secret(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
179	        self._require_key(key)
180	        reason = reason_field(raw)
181	
182	        def unfreeze_operation() -> str:
183	            document = self._document(secret_id)
184	            return f"unfreeze-secret:{secret_id}:e{document['status_epoch']}"
185	
186	        def unfreeze() -> dict[str, Any]:
187	            document = self._document(secret_id)
188	            if document["status"] != "frozen":
189	                raise SecretNotFrozen(f"secret {secret_id} is not frozen")
190	            now = self.store.now()
191	            document["status"] = "active"
192	            document["status_reason"] = reason
193	            document["status_changed_at"] = now
194	            self.store.connection.execute(
195	                "UPDATE secrets SET document = ? WHERE id = ?",
196	                (self.store.encode(document), secret_id),
197	            )
198	            self._append(secret_id, "secret_unfrozen", {"version": document["version"], "reason": reason})
199	            return self._record(secret_id, document)
200	
201	        return self._idempotent(key, unfreeze_operation, unfreeze)
202	
203	    @staticmethod
204	    def _require_active(document: dict[str, Any], secret_id: str) -> None:
205	        if document["status"] == "frozen":
206	            raise SecretFrozen(f"secret {secret_id} is frozen")
207	
208	    # ------------------------------------------------------------- distribution
209	    def distribute_share(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
210	        self._require_key(key)
211	        holder = single_field(raw, "holder", "share distribution body")
212	        document = self._document(secret_id)
213	        operation = f"distribute-share:{secret_id}:v{document['version']}:{holder}"
214	
215	        def distribute() -> dict[str, Any]:
216	            document = self._document(secret_id)
217	            self._require_active(document, secret_id)
218	            if holder not in document["holders"]:
219	                raise ValidationError(f"holder {holder} is not registered for secret {secret_id}")
220	            share_id = _share_id(secret_id, document["version"], holder)
221	            row = self.store.connection.execute(
222	                "SELECT value, distributed_at FROM shares WHERE share_id = ?", (share_id,)
223	            ).fetchone()
224	            if row is None:
225	                raise IntegrityFailure(f"share {share_id} is missing from the store")
226	            if row["distributed_at"] is not None:
227	                raise ShareAlreadyDistributed(f"share {share_id} was already distributed")
228	            now = self.store.now()
229	            self.store.connection.execute(
230	                "UPDATE shares SET distributed_at = ? WHERE share_id = ?", (now, share_id)
231	            )
232	            self._append(secret_id, "share_distributed",
233	                         {"share_id": share_id, "holder": holder, "version": document["version"]})
234	            return {
235	                "secret_id": secret_id,
236	                "version": document["version"],
237	                "threshold": document["threshold"],
238	                "share": {
239	                    "share_id": share_id,
240	                    "holder": holder,
241	                    "value": row["value"],
242	                    "distributed_at": now,
243	                },
244	            }
245	
246	        return self._idempotent(
247	            key, operation, distribute, blocked=(secret_id, "distribute_share")
248	        )
249	
250	    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- approvals
251	    def record_approval(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
252	        self._require_key(key)
253	        approver = single_field(raw, "approver", "approval body")
254	        document = self._document(secret_id)
255	        operation = f"record-approval:{secret_id}:v{document['version']}:{approver}"
256	
257	        def record() -> dict[str, Any]:
258	            document = self._document(secret_id)
259	            self._require_active(document, secret_id)
260	            mode, approvers = self._roles(document)
261	            if approver not in approvers:
262	                role = "approver" if mode == "separated" else "holder"
263	                raise ValidationError(f"approver {approver} is not a registered {role} of secret {secret_id}")
264	            version = document["version"]
265	            existing = self.store.connection.execute(
266	                "SELECT consumed_at FROM approvals WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ? AND approver = ?",
267	                (secret_id, version, approver),
268	            ).fetchone()
269	            if existing is not None and existing["consumed_at"] is None:
270	                raise DuplicateApproval(f"approver {approver} has already approved version {version}")
271	            now = self.store.now()
272	            if existing is None:
273	                self.store.connection.execute(
274	                    "INSERT INTO approvals(secret_id, version, approver, created_at, consumed_at) "
275	                    "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL)",
276	                    (secret_id, version, approver, now),
277	                )
278	            else:
279	                self.store.connection.execute(
280	                    "UPDATE approvals SET created_at = ?, consumed_at = NULL "
281	                    "WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ? AND approver = ?",
282	                    (now, secret_id, version, approver),
283	                )
284	            recorded = self._approval_count(secret_id, version)
285	            required = document["approvals_required"]
286	            self._append(secret_id, "approval_recorded", {
287	                "approver": approver,
288	                "version": version,
289	                "approvals": recorded,
290	                "required": required,
291	                "approval_mode": mode,
292	                "approvers": approvers,
293	            })
294	            return {
295	                "secret_id": secret_id,
296	                "approver": approver,
297	                "version": version,
298	                "approvals": recorded,
299	                "required": required,
300	                "satisfied": recorded >= required,
301	                "recorded_at": now,
302	            }
303	
304	        return self._idempotent(
305	            key, operation, record, blocked=(secret_id, "record_approval")
306	        )
307	
308	    # ------------------------------------------------------------- reconstruct
309	    def reconstruct(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
310	        self._require_key(key)
311	        claims = parse_share_claims(raw)
312	        self._document(secret_id)
313	        try:
314	            return self._idempotent(
315	                key,
316	                f"reconstruct:{secret_id}",
317	                lambda: self._reconstruct(secret_id, claims),
318	                blocked=(secret_id, "reconstruct"),
319	            )
320	        except ThresholdSafeError as error:
321	            if error.code in AUDITED_FAILURES:
322	                self._audit_failure(secret_id, error, len(claims))
323	            raise
324	
325	    def _reconstruct(self, secret_id: str, claims: list[ShareClaim]) -> dict[str, Any]:
326	        document = self._document(secret_id)
327	        self._require_active(document, secret_id)
328	        version, threshold = document["version"], document["threshold"]
329	        points: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
330	        used: list[str] = []
331	        holders: list[str] = []
332	        for claim in claims:
333	            row = self.store.connection.execute(
334	                "SELECT * FROM shares WHERE share_id = ?", (claim.share_id,)
335	            ).fetchone()
336	            if row is None or row["secret_id"] != secret_id:
337	                raise NotFoundError(f"share {claim.share_id} was not found for secret {secret_id}")
338	            if row["version"] != version:
339	                raise StaleShare(
340	                    f"share {claim.share_id} belongs to version {row['version']} and was invalidated "
341	                    f"by rotation to version {version}"
342	                )
343	            if row["distributed_at"] is None:
344	                raise ShareNotDistributed(f"share {claim.share_id} has not been distributed to its holder")
345	            if row["value"] != claim.value:
346	                raise ShareMismatch(f"share {claim.share_id} value does not match the issued commitment")
347	            points.append((int(row["coordinate"]), int(row["value"], 16)))
348	            used.append(claim.share_id)
349	            holders.append(row["holder"])
350	        if len(points) < threshold:
351	            raise InsufficientShares(f"reconstruction requires {threshold} shares but {len(points)} were provided")
352	        if len({coordinate for coordinate, _ in points}) != len(points):
353	            raise ValidationError("shares must come from distinct holders")
354	        required = document["approvals_required"]
355	        recorded = self._approval_count(secret_id, version)
356	        if recorded < required:
357	            raise InsufficientApprovals(
358	                f"reconstruction requires {required} approvals for version {version} but {recorded} were recorded"
359	            )
360	        self._authorize(secret_id, document, "reconstruct", version, recorded, len(points))
361	        try:
362	            secret = shamir.combine(points).to_bytes(document["secret_length"], "big")
363	        except OverflowError as error:
364	            raise IntegrityFailure("reconstructed value does not fit the recorded secret length") from error
365	        if _secret_digest(secret) != document["secret_digest"]:
366	            raise IntegrityFailure("reconstructed secret does not match the stored commitment")
367	        now = self.store.now()
368	        self._consume_approvals(secret_id, version, now, recorded, "reconstruct")
369	        self._append(secret_id, "secret_reconstructed", {
370	            "version": version,
371	            "threshold": threshold,
372	            "share_ids": sorted(used),
373	            "holders": sorted(holders),
374	        })
375	        return {
376	            "id": secret_id,
377	            "version": version,
378	            "secret": secret.decode("utf-8"),
379	            "threshold": threshold,
380	            "used_shares": sorted(used),
381	            "holders": sorted(holders),

386	    def rotate(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
387	        self._require_key(key)
388	        spec = RotationSpec.parse(raw)
389	        document = self._document(secret_id)
390	        operation = f"rotate:{secret_id}:v{document['version']}"
391	
392	        def apply() -> dict[str, Any]:
393	            document = self._document(secret_id)
394	            self._require_active(document, secret_id)
395	            previous = document["version"]
396	            required = document["approvals_required"]
397	            recorded = self._approval_count(secret_id, previous)
398	            if recorded < required:
399	                raise InsufficientApprovals(
400	                    f"rotation requires {required} approvals for version {previous} but {recorded} were recorded"
401	                )
402	            threshold = spec.threshold if spec.threshold is not None else document["threshold"]
403	            holders = spec.holders if spec.holders is not None else tuple(document["holders"])
404	            approvals_required = (
405	                spec.approvals_required if spec.approvals_required is not None else document["approvals_required"]
406	            )
407	            # Resolve the target approval mode before touching any state: an
408	            # omitted approvers field continues the current mode (legacy follows
409	            # the final holders, separated keeps its roster), an explicit null
410	            # returns to legacy, and an array installs a separated roster.
411	            if spec.approvers is UNSET:
412	                mode = document.get("approval_mode", "legacy")
413	                approvers = list(document["approvers"]) if mode == "separated" else None
414	            elif spec.approvers is None:
415	                mode, approvers = "legacy", None
416	            else:
417	                mode, approvers = "separated", list(spec.approvers)
418	            resolve_roles(threshold, holders, approvals_required, mode, approvers)
419	            self._authorize(secret_id, document, "rotate", previous, recorded, 0)
420	            secret = spec.secret if spec.secret is not None else self._recover(secret_id, document)
421	            now = self.store.now()
422	            self._consume_approvals(secret_id, previous, now, recorded, "rotate")
423	            invalidated = self.store.connection.execute(
424	                "UPDATE shares SET invalidated_at = ? WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ? AND invalidated_at IS NULL",
425	                (now, secret_id, previous),
426	            ).rowcount
427	            version = previous + 1
428	            self._issue(version, secret_id, holders, shamir.split(secret, threshold, len(holders), self._source(spec.seed)))
429	            history = document.get("versions")
430	            if history is None:
431	                # A document written before approval modes existed: every past
432	                # version is legacy, with the holders acting as approvers.
433	                history = self._legacy_history(secret_id, previous)
434	            effective = approvers if approvers is not None else list(holders)
435	            document["versions"] = history + [{
436	                "version": version,
437	                "approval_mode": mode,
438	                "holders": list(holders),
439	                "approvers": effective,
440	            }]
441	            document.update({
442	                "version": version,
443	                "threshold": threshold,
444	                "holders": list(holders),
445	                "approvals_required": approvals_required,
446	                "approval_mode": mode,
447	                "approvers": approvers,
448	                "secret_digest": _secret_digest(secret),
449	                "secret_length": len(secret),
450	                "updated_at": now,
451	            })

453	                document["policy"] = spec.policy

455	                "UPDATE secrets SET document = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
456	                (self.store.encode(document), now, secret_id),
457	            )
458	            self._append(secret_id, "secret_rotated", {
459	                "version": version,
460	                "previous_version": previous,
461	                "threshold": threshold,
462	                "approvals_required": approvals_required,
463	                "approval_mode": mode,
464	                "approvers": effective,
465	                "holders": list(holders),
466	                "share_count": len(holders),
467	                "invalidated_shares": invalidated,
468	                "secret_changed": spec.secret is not None,
469	            })

472	        return self._idempotent(key, operation, apply, blocked=(secret_id, "rotate"))

540	            "SELECT sequence, type, payload, occurred_at, previous_hash, hash FROM audit_events "
541	            "WHERE secret_id = ? ORDER BY sequence",
542	            (secret_id,),
543	        ).fetchall()
544	        events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

546	        chain_valid = True
547	        for row in rows:
548	            events.append({

568	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
569	    @staticmethod
570	    def _roles(document: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
571	        """Effective approval mode and approver roster of the current version.
572	
573	        Documents written before approval modes existed carry no role fields
574	        and are read as legacy: the holders are the approvers.

605	        for holder, (coordinate, value) in zip(holders, points):

615	        rows = self.store.connection.execute(
616	            "SELECT coordinate, value FROM shares WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ? ORDER BY coordinate LIMIT ?",

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import sqlite3
from typing import Any, Callable

from . import shamir
from .backup import (
    BACKUP_VERSION,
    ZERO_HASH,
    event_hash as _event_hash,
    share_commitment as _share_commitment,
    stamp as _stamp,
    verify as _verify,
)
from .errors import (
    ConflictError,
    DuplicateApproval,
    InsufficientApprovals,
    InsufficientShares,
    IntegrityFailure,
    NotFoundError,
    PolicyDenied,
    SecretFrozen,
    SecretNotFrozen,
    ShareAlreadyDistributed,
    ShareMismatch,
    ShareNotDistributed,
    StaleShare,
    ThresholdSafeError,
    ValidationError,
)
from .model import (
    UNSET,
    RotationSpec,
    SecretSpec,
    ShareClaim,
    parse_share_claims,
    reason_field,
    resolve_roles,
    single_field,
)
from .policy import evaluate as evaluate_policy
from .shamir import RandomSource, SeededRandomSource, SystemRandomSource
from .store import Store

# Rejected attempts that are custody decisions rather than malformed requests
# are worth recording even though they changed nothing else.
AUDITED_FAILURES = frozenset(
    {
        "insufficient_shares",
        "insufficient_approvals",
        "stale_share",
        "share_not_distributed",
        "share_mismatch",
        "integrity_failure",
    }
)


def _share_id(secret_id: str, version: int, holder: str) -> str:
    return f"{secret_id}.v{version}.{holder}"


def _secret_digest(secret: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(b"thresholdsafe:v1:secret:" + secret).hexdigest()


class ThresholdSafe:
    def __init__(self, database: str, source: RandomSource | None = None):
        self.store = Store(database)
        self.source: RandomSource = source if source is not None else SystemRandomSource()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ create
    def create_secret(self, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        spec = SecretSpec.parse(raw)

        def create() -> dict[str, Any]:
            now = self.store.now()
            points = shamir.split(spec.secret, spec.threshold, len(spec.holders), self._source(spec.seed))
            mode = "separated" if spec.approvers is not None else "legacy"
            approvers = list(spec.approvers) if spec.approvers is not None else list(spec.holders)
            document = {
                "id": spec.id,
                "name": spec.name,
                "version": 1,
                "threshold": spec.threshold,
                "holders": list(spec.holders),
                "approvals_required": spec.approvals_required,
                "approval_mode": mode,
                "approvers": list(spec.approvers) if spec.approvers is not None else None,
                "versions": [{
                    "version": 1,
                    "approval_mode": mode,
                    "holders": list(spec.holders),
                    "approvers": approvers,
                }],
                "secret_digest": _secret_digest(spec.secret),
                "secret_length": len(spec.secret),
                "policy": spec.policy,
                "status": "active",
                "status_reason": None,
                "status_changed_at": now,
                "status_epoch": 0,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            try:
                self.store.connection.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO secrets(id, document, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (spec.id, self.store.encode(document), now, now),
                )
            except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:
                if "UNIQUE constraint" not in str(error):
                    raise
                raise ConflictError(f"secret {spec.id} already exists") from error
            self._issue(1, spec.id, spec.holders, points)
            self._append(spec.id, "secret_created", {
                "version": 1,
                "name": spec.name,
                "threshold": spec.threshold,
                "approvals_required": spec.approvals_required,
                "approval_mode": mode,
                "approvers": approvers,
                "holders": list(spec.holders),
                "share_count": len(spec.holders),
                "secret_length": len(spec.secret),
                "deterministic": spec.seed is not None,
            })
            return self._record(spec.id)

        return self._idempotent(key, f"create-secret:{spec.id}", create)

    def get_secret(self, secret_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._record(secret_id)

    def get_policy(self, secret_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the persistent authorization policy of one secret.

        Read-only: a frozen secret answers exactly like an active one, and no
        audit event or idempotency record is written. Secrets without a policy
        respond with ``{"policy": None}``.
        """
        return {"policy": self._document(secret_id).get("policy")}

    # ------------------------------------------------------- freeze / unfreeze
    def freeze_secret(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._require_key(key)
        reason = reason_field(raw)

        def freeze_operation() -> str:
            document = self._document(secret_id)
            epoch = document["status_epoch"]
            # A completed freeze carries the epoch it entered; a pending freeze
            # while active would open the next epoch, so retries after an
            # unfreeze cannot replay an older freeze cycle's response.
            scope = epoch if document["status"] == "frozen" else epoch + 1
            return f"freeze-secret:{secret_id}:e{scope}"

        def freeze() -> dict[str, Any]:
            document = self._document(secret_id)
            if document["status"] == "frozen":
                raise SecretFrozen(f"secret {secret_id} is already frozen")
            now = self.store.now()
            document["status"] = "frozen"
            document["status_reason"] = reason
            document["status_changed_at"] = now
            document["status_epoch"] = document["status_epoch"] + 1
            self.store.connection.execute(
                "UPDATE secrets SET document = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (self.store.encode(document), secret_id),
            )
            self._append(secret_id, "secret_frozen", {"version": document["version"], "reason": reason})
            return self._record(secret_id, document)

        return self._idempotent(key, freeze_operation, freeze)

    def unfreeze_secret(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._require_key(key)
        reason = reason_field(raw)

        def unfreeze_operation() -> str:
            document = self._document(secret_id)
            return f"unfreeze-secret:{secret_id}:e{document['status_epoch']}"

        def unfreeze() -> dict[str, Any]:
            document = self._document(secret_id)
            if document["status"] != "frozen":
                raise SecretNotFrozen(f"secret {secret_id} is not frozen")
            now = self.store.now()
            document["status"] = "active"
            document["status_reason"] = reason
            document["status_changed_at"] = now
            self.store.connection.execute(
                "UPDATE secrets SET document = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (self.store.encode(document), secret_id),
            )
            self._append(secret_id, "secret_unfrozen", {"version": document["version"], "reason": reason})
            return self._record(secret_id, document)

        return self._idempotent(key, unfreeze_operation, unfreeze)

    @staticmethod
    def _require_active(document: dict[str, Any], secret_id: str) -> None:
        if document["status"] == "frozen":
            raise SecretFrozen(f"secret {secret_id} is frozen")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- distribution
    def distribute_share(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._require_key(key)
        holder = single_field(raw, "holder", "share distribution body")
        document = self._document(secret_id)
        operation = f"distribute-share:{secret_id}:v{document['version']}:{holder}"

        def distribute() -> dict[str, Any]:
            document = self._document(secret_id)
            self._require_active(document, secret_id)
            if holder not in document["holders"]:
                raise ValidationError(f"holder {holder} is not registered for secret {secret_id}")
            share_id = _share_id(secret_id, document["version"], holder)
            row = self.store.connection.execute(
                "SELECT value, distributed_at FROM shares WHERE share_id = ?", (share_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise IntegrityFailure(f"share {share_id} is missing from the store")
            if row["distributed_at"] is not None:
                raise ShareAlreadyDistributed(f"share {share_id} was already distributed")
            now = self.store.now()
            self.store.connection.execute(
                "UPDATE shares SET distributed_at = ? WHERE share_id = ?", (now, share_id)
            )
            self._append(secret_id, "share_distributed",
                         {"share_id": share_id, "holder": holder, "version": document["version"]})
            return {
                "secret_id": secret_id,
                "version": document["version"],
                "threshold": document["threshold"],
                "share": {
                    "share_id": share_id,
                    "holder": holder,
                    "value": row["value"],
                    "distributed_at": now,
                },
            }

        return self._idempotent(
            key, operation, distribute, blocked=(secret_id, "distribute_share")
        )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- approvals
    def record_approval(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._require_key(key)
        approver = single_field(raw, "approver", "approval body")
        document = self._document(secret_id)
        operation = f"record-approval:{secret_id}:v{document['version']}:{approver}"

        def record() -> dict[str, Any]:
            document = self._document(secret_id)
            self._require_active(document, secret_id)
            mode, approvers = self._roles(document)
            if approver not in approvers:
                role = "approver" if mode == "separated" else "holder"
                raise ValidationError(f"approver {approver} is not a registered {role} of secret {secret_id}")
            version = document["version"]
            existing = self.store.connection.execute(
                "SELECT consumed_at FROM approvals WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ? AND approver = ?",
                (secret_id, version, approver),
            ).fetchone()
            if existing is not None and existing["consumed_at"] is None:
                raise DuplicateApproval(f"approver {approver} has already approved version {version}")
            now = self.store.now()
            if existing is None:
                self.store.connection.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO approvals(secret_id, version, approver, created_at, consumed_at) "
                    "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL)",
                    (secret_id, version, approver, now),
                )
            else:
                self.store.connection.execute(
                    "UPDATE approvals SET created_at = ?, consumed_at = NULL "
                    "WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ? AND approver = ?",
                    (now, secret_id, version, approver),
                )
            recorded = self._approval_count(secret_id, version)
            required = document["approvals_required"]
            self._append(secret_id, "approval_recorded", {
                "approver": approver,
                "version": version,
                "approvals": recorded,
                "required": required,
                "approval_mode": mode,
                "approvers": approvers,
            })
            return {
                "secret_id": secret_id,
                "approver": approver,
                "version": version,
                "approvals": recorded,
                "required": required,
                "satisfied": recorded >= required,
                "recorded_at": now,
            }

        return self._idempotent(
            key, operation, record, blocked=(secret_id, "record_approval")
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- reconstruct
    def reconstruct(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._require_key(key)
        claims = parse_share_claims(raw)
        self._document(secret_id)
        try:
            return self._idempotent(
                key,
                f"reconstruct:{secret_id}",
                lambda: self._reconstruct(secret_id, claims),
                blocked=(secret_id, "reconstruct"),
            )
        except ThresholdSafeError as error:
            if error.code in AUDITED_FAILURES:
                self._audit_failure(secret_id, error, len(claims))
            raise

    def _reconstruct(self, secret_id: str, claims: list[ShareClaim]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        document = self._document(secret_id)
        self._require_active(document, secret_id)
        version, threshold = document["version"], document["threshold"]
        points: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
        used: list[str] = []
        holders: list[str] = []
        for claim in claims:
            row = self.store.connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM shares WHERE share_id = ?", (claim.share_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None or row["secret_id"] != secret_id:
                raise NotFoundError(f"share {claim.share_id} was not found for secret {secret_id}")
            if row["version"] != version:
                raise StaleShare(
                    f"share {claim.share_id} belongs to version {row['version']} and was invalidated "
                    f"by rotation to version {version}"
                )
            if row["distributed_at"] is None:
                raise ShareNotDistributed(f"share {claim.share_id} has not been distributed to its holder")
            if row["value"] != claim.value:
                raise ShareMismatch(f"share {claim.share_id} value does not match the issued commitment")
            points.append((int(row["coordinate"]), int(row["value"], 16)))
            used.append(claim.share_id)
            holders.append(row["holder"])
        if len(points) < threshold:
            raise InsufficientShares(f"reconstruction requires {threshold} shares but {len(points)} were provided")
        if len({coordinate for coordinate, _ in points}) != len(points):
            raise ValidationError("shares must come from distinct holders")
        required = document["approvals_required"]
        recorded = self._approval_count(secret_id, version)
        if recorded < required:
            raise InsufficientApprovals(
                f"reconstruction requires {required} approvals for version {version} but {recorded} were recorded"
            )
        self._authorize(secret_id, document, "reconstruct", version, recorded, len(points))
        try:
            secret = shamir.combine(points).to_bytes(document["secret_length"], "big")
        except OverflowError as error:
            raise IntegrityFailure("reconstructed value does not fit the recorded secret length") from error
        if _secret_digest(secret) != document["secret_digest"]:
            raise IntegrityFailure("reconstructed secret does not match the stored commitment")
        now = self.store.now()
        self._consume_approvals(secret_id, version, now, recorded, "reconstruct")
        self._append(secret_id, "secret_reconstructed", {
            "version": version,
            "threshold": threshold,
            "share_ids": sorted(used),
            "holders": sorted(holders),
        })
        return {
            "id": secret_id,
            "version": version,
            "secret": secret.decode("utf-8"),
            "threshold": threshold,
            "used_shares": sorted(used),
            "holders": sorted(holders),
            "reconstructed_at": now,
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- rotate
    def rotate(self, secret_id: str, raw: Any, key: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._require_key(key)
        spec = RotationSpec.parse(raw)
        document = self._document(secret_id)
        operation = f"rotate:{secret_id}:v{document['version']}"

        def apply() -> dict[str, Any]:
            document = self._document(secret_id)
            self._require_active(document, secret_id)
            previous = document["version"]
            required = document["approvals_required"]
            recorded = self._approval_count(secret_id, previous)
            if recorded < required:
                raise InsufficientApprovals(
                    f"rotation requires {required} approvals for version {previous} but {recorded} were recorded"
                )
            threshold = spec.threshold if spec.threshold is not None else document["threshold"]
            holders = spec.holders if spec.holders is not None else tuple(document["holders"])
            approvals_required = (
                spec.approvals_required if spec.approvals_required is not None else document["approvals_required"]
            )
            # Resolve the target approval mode before touching any state: an
            # omitted approvers field continues the current mode (legacy follows
            # the final holders, separated keeps its roster), an explicit null
            # returns to legacy, and an array installs a separated roster.
            if spec.approvers is UNSET:
                mode = document.get("approval_mode", "legacy")
                approvers = list(document["approvers"]) if mode == "separated" else None
            elif spec.approvers is None:
                mode, approvers = "legacy", None
            else:
                mode, approvers = "separated", list(spec.approvers)
            resolve_roles(threshold, holders, approvals_required, mode, approvers)
            self._authorize(secret_id, document, "rotate", previous, recorded, 0)
            secret = spec.secret if spec.secret is not None else self._recover(secret_id, document)
            now = self.store.now()
            self._consume_approvals(secret_id, previous, now, recorded, "rotate")
            invalidated = self.store.connection.execute(
                "UPDATE shares SET invalidated_at = ? WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ? AND invalidated_at IS NULL",
                (now, secret_id, previous),
            ).rowcount
            version = previous + 1
            self._issue(version, secret_id, holders, shamir.split(secret, threshold, len(holders), self._source(spec.seed)))
            history = document.get("versions")
            if history is None:
                # A document written before approval modes existed: every past
                # version is legacy, with the holders acting as approvers.
                history = self._legacy_history(secret_id, previous)
            effective = approvers if approvers is not None else list(holders)
            document["versions"] = history + [{
                "version": version,
                "approval_mode": mode,
                "holders": list(holders),
                "approvers": effective,
            }]
            document.update({
                "version": version,
                "threshold": threshold,
                "holders": list(holders),
                "approvals_required": approvals_required,
                "approval_mode": mode,
                "approvers": approvers,
                "secret_digest": _secret_digest(secret),
                "secret_length": len(secret),
                "updated_at": now,
            })
            if spec.policy is not UNSET:
                document["policy"] = spec.policy
            self.store.connection.execute(
                "UPDATE secrets SET document = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (self.store.encode(document), now, secret_id),
            )
            self._append(secret_id, "secret_rotated", {
                "version": version,
                "previous_version": previous,
                "threshold": threshold,
                "approvals_required": approvals_required,
                "approval_mode": mode,
                "approvers": effective,
                "holders": list(holders),
                "share_count": len(holders),
                "invalidated_shares": invalidated,
                "secret_changed": spec.secret is not None,
            })
            return self._record(secret_id)

        return self._idempotent(key, operation, apply, blocked=(secret_id, "rotate"))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ backup
    def export_backup(self, secret_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Export a self-contained, checksummed backup of one secret.

        Read-only: a frozen secret exports exactly like an active one, and no
        audit event or idempotency record is written. The plaintext secret is
        never included — only its digest and length — but share values are, so
        the backup is sensitive material.
        """
        document = self._document(secret_id)
        shares = self.store.connection.execute(
            "SELECT share_id, secret_id, version, holder, coordinate, value, commitment, "
            "distributed_at, invalidated_at FROM shares WHERE secret_id = ? "
            "ORDER BY version, coordinate",
            (secret_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        approvals = self.store.connection.execute(
            "SELECT secret_id, version, approver, created_at, consumed_at FROM approvals "
            "WHERE secret_id = ? ORDER BY version, approver",
            (secret_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        events = self.store.connection.execute(
            "SELECT sequence, type, payload, occurred_at, previous_hash, hash FROM audit_events "
            "WHERE secret_id = ? ORDER BY sequence",
            (secret_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        versions = document.get("versions")
        if versions is None:
            # A document written before approval modes existed: derive the
            # per-version rosters from the shares, all in legacy mode.
            versions = self._legacy_history(secret_id, document["version"])
        return _stamp({
            "backup_version": BACKUP_VERSION,
            "generated_at": self.store.now(),
            "authorization_policy": document.get("policy"),
            "secret": {
                key: value
                for key, value in document.items()
                if key not in ("policy", "approval_mode", "approvers", "versions")
            },
            "versions": [dict(entry) for entry in versions],
            "shares": [dict(row) for row in shares],
            "approvals": [dict(row) for row in approvals],
            "audit_events": [
                {
                    "sequence": row["sequence"],
                    "type": row["type"],
                    "payload": self.store.decode(row["payload"]),
                    "occurred_at": row["occurred_at"],
                    "previous_hash": row["previous_hash"],
                    "hash": row["hash"],
                }
                for row in events
            ],
        })

    def verify_backup(self, raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Independently verify a backup document without touching service state."""
        if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) != {"backup"}:
            raise ValidationError("backup verification body must contain exactly backup")
        return _verify(raw["backup"])

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------- audit
    def audit(self, secret_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        document = self._document(secret_id)
        rows = self.store.connection.execute(
            "SELECT sequence, type, payload, occurred_at, previous_hash, hash FROM audit_events "
            "WHERE secret_id = ? ORDER BY sequence",
            (secret_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        previous = ZERO_HASH
        chain_valid = True
        for row in rows:
            events.append({
                "sequence": row["sequence"],
                "type": row["type"],
                "payload": self.store.decode(row["payload"]),
                "occurred_at": row["occurred_at"],
                "previous_hash": row["previous_hash"],
                "hash": row["hash"],
            })
            expected = _event_hash(row["previous_hash"], row["sequence"], row["type"], row["payload"], row["occurred_at"])
            if row["previous_hash"] != previous or row["hash"] != expected:
                chain_valid = False
            previous = row["hash"]
        return {
            "secret_id": secret_id,
            "version": document["version"],
            "chain_valid": chain_valid,
            "head_hash": previous,
            "events": events,
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
    @staticmethod
    def _roles(document: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
        """Effective approval mode and approver roster of the current version.

        Documents written before approval modes existed carry no role fields
        and are read as legacy: the holders are the approvers.
        """
        mode = document.get("approval_mode", "legacy")
        if mode == "separated":
            return mode, list(document["approvers"])
        return "legacy", list(document["holders"])

    def _legacy_history(self, secret_id: str, upto: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Per-version role snapshots for a pre-roles document, all legacy."""
        rows = self.store.connection.execute(
            "SELECT version, holder FROM shares WHERE secret_id = ? AND version <= ? "
            "ORDER BY version, coordinate",
            (secret_id, upto),
        ).fetchall()
        history: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for row in rows:
            if not history or history[-1]["version"] != row["version"]:
                history.append({
                    "version": row["version"],
                    "approval_mode": "legacy",
                    "holders": [],
                    "approvers": [],
                })
            history[-1]["holders"].append(row["holder"])
            history[-1]["approvers"].append(row["holder"])
        return history

    def _source(self, seed: int | None) -> RandomSource:
        return SeededRandomSource(seed) if seed is not None else self.source

    def _issue(self, version: int, secret_id: str, holders: tuple[str, ...], points: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> None:
        for holder, (coordinate, value) in zip(holders, points):
            rendered = shamir.format_share(value)
            self.store.connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO shares(share_id, secret_id, version, holder, coordinate, value, commitment, "
                "distributed_at, invalidated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, NULL)",
                (_share_id(secret_id, version, holder), secret_id, version, holder, coordinate, rendered,
                 _share_commitment(secret_id, version, holder, rendered)),
            )

    def _recover(self, secret_id: str, document: dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
        rows = self.store.connection.execute(
            "SELECT coordinate, value FROM shares WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ? ORDER BY coordinate LIMIT ?",
            (secret_id, document["version"], document["threshold"]),
        ).fetchall()
        if len(rows) < document["threshold"]:
            raise IntegrityFailure("stored shares are insufficient to re-share the current secret")
        points = [(int(row["coordinate"]), int(row["value"], 16)) for row in rows]
        try:
            return shamir.combine(points).to_bytes(document["secret_length"], "big")
        except OverflowError as error:
            raise IntegrityFailure("stored shares do not reproduce the recorded secret") from error

    def _record(self, secret_id: str, document: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if document is None:
            document = self._document(secret_id)
        rows = self.store.connection.execute(
            "SELECT distributed_at FROM shares WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ?",
            (secret_id, document["version"]),
        ).fetchall()
        recorded = self._approval_count(secret_id, document["version"])
        required = document["approvals_required"]
        mode, approvers = self._roles(document)
        return {
            "id": secret_id,
            "name": document["name"],
            "version": document["version"],
            "threshold": document["threshold"],
            "holders": list(document["holders"]),
            "approvals_required": required,
            "approval_mode": mode,
            "approvers": approvers,
            "share_count": len(rows),
            "distributed_shares": sum(1 for row in rows if row["distributed_at"] is not None),
            "approvals": {"recorded": recorded, "required": required, "satisfied": recorded >= required},
            "secret_length": document["secret_length"],
            "status": document["status"],
            "status_reason": document["status_reason"],
            "status_changed_at": document["status_changed_at"],
            "created_at": document["created_at"],
            "updated_at": document["updated_at"],
        }

    def _document(self, secret_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        row = self.store.connection.execute("SELECT document FROM secrets WHERE id = ?", (secret_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"secret {secret_id} was not found")
        return self.store.decode(row["document"])

    def _approval_count(self, secret_id: str, version: int) -> int:
        row = self.store.connection.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM approvals WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ? AND consumed_at IS NULL",
            (secret_id, version),
        ).fetchone()
        return int(row["total"])

    def _authorize(
        self,
        secret_id: str,
        document: dict[str, Any],
        action: str,
        version: int,
        approvals: int,
        presented_shares: int,
    ) -> None:
        """Evaluate the persistent authorization policy, if one is attached.

        Runs only after the request, status, share and approval checks have
        passed. A denial is a custody decision: it is appended to the audit
        chain as ``authorization_denied`` and raised as ``policy_denied``, but
        consumes no approvals, moves no shares and stores no idempotency
        record. Facts are the pre-execution values; ``presented_shares`` is
        the number of distinct shares that passed validation (0 for rotation).
        """
        policy = document.get("policy")
        if policy is None:
            return
        facts = {
            "action": action,
            "version": version,
            "threshold": document["threshold"],
            "approvals": approvals,
            "presented_shares": presented_shares,
        }
        if evaluate_policy(policy, facts):
            return
        self._append(secret_id, "authorization_denied", {
            "action": action,
            "version": version,
            "presented_shares": presented_shares,
            "approvals": approvals,
        })
        raise PolicyDenied(f"the authorization policy of secret {secret_id} denies {action}")

    def _consume_approvals(self, secret_id: str, version: int, now: str, recorded: int, reason: str) -> None:
        self.store.connection.execute(
            "UPDATE approvals SET consumed_at = ? WHERE secret_id = ? AND version = ? AND consumed_at IS NULL",
            (now, secret_id, version),
        )
        self._append(secret_id, "approvals_consumed", {"version": version, "approvals": recorded, "reason": reason})

    def _audit_failure(self, secret_id: str, error: ThresholdSafeError, shares_provided: int) -> None:
        version = self._document(secret_id)["version"]
        with self.store.transaction():
            self._append(secret_id, "reconstruction_failed", {
                "version": version,
                "code": error.code,
                "shares_provided": shares_provided,
                "message": str(error),
            })

    def _append(self, secret_id: str, event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        row = self.store.connection.execute(
            "SELECT hash FROM audit_events WHERE secret_id = ? ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1", (secret_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        previous = row["hash"] if row else ZERO_HASH
        sequence = self.store.connection.execute(
            "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 AS sequence FROM audit_events WHERE secret_id = ?", (secret_id,)
        ).fetchone()["sequence"]
        occurred_at = self.store.now()
        encoded = self.store.encode(payload)
        self.store.connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_events(secret_id, sequence, type, payload, occurred_at, previous_hash, hash) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (secret_id, sequence, event_type, encoded, occurred_at, previous,
             _event_hash(previous, sequence, event_type, encoded, occurred_at)),
        )

    def _idempotent(
        self,
        key: str | None,
        operation: str | Callable[[], str],
        action: Callable[[], dict[str, Any]],
        blocked: tuple[str, str] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._require_key(key)
        rejection: SecretFrozen | PolicyDenied | None = None
        with self.store.transaction() as connection:
            operation_name = operation() if callable(operation) else operation
            existing = connection.execute(
                "SELECT operation, response FROM idempotency WHERE key = ?", (key,)
            ).fetchone()
            if existing:
                if existing["operation"] != operation_name:
                    raise ConflictError("idempotency key was already used for another operation")
                return self.store.decode(existing["response"])
            try:
                response = action()
            except SecretFrozen as error:
                # The guard is the first thing the action checks, so nothing was
                # mutated. Commit (at most) the operation_blocked event, store no
                # idempotency record, and surface the rejection after commit.
                rejection = error
                if blocked is not None:
                    secret_id, operation_name_recorded = blocked
                    self._append(secret_id, "operation_blocked",
                                 {"operation": operation_name_recorded, "code": error.code})
            except PolicyDenied as error:
                # The action already appended its authorization_denied event;
                # commit that event but store no idempotency record, so a
                # retry with the same key re-evaluates the policy.
                rejection = error
            else:
                connection.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO idempotency(key, operation, response) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                    (key, operation_name, self.store.encode(response)),
                )
                return response
        assert rejection is not None
        raise rejection

    @staticmethod
    def _require_key(key: str | None) -> None:
        if not key:
            raise ValidationError("Idempotency-Key header is required")

1	"""Self-contained backup format and its independent verifier.
2	
3	A backup exported by ``ThresholdSafe.export_backup`` carries everything needed
4	to reconstruct the custody state of one secret — the secret record (without
5	the plaintext secret), the persistent authorization policy, every share of
6	every version, all approvals and the full audit stream — plus a SHA-256
7	checksum over the remaining top-level values. ``verify`` re-checks such a
8	document without touching any service state: structural problems raise
9	:class:`ValidationError`, while a well-formed document whose contents are
10	inconsistent raises :class:`BackupIntegrity`.
11	
12	Two formats are accepted. ``thresholdsafe-backup-v1`` is the original layout
13	and is verified unchanged. ``thresholdsafe-backup-v2`` adds the top-level
14	``authorization_policy`` field (a policy expression or ``null``), which is
15	covered by the checksum. ``thresholdsafe-backup-v3`` — what new exports
16	produce — adds ``versions``: a snapshot of the holder and approver rosters of
17	every version from 1 to the current one, so the role attribution of each
18	share and approval can be verified against the version it belongs to. v1 and
19	v2 documents carry no role information and are read in legacy mode, where the
20	approvers of a version are exactly its holders.
21	"""
22	
23	from __future__ import annotations
24	
25	import hashlib
26	import json
27	import re
28	from typing import Any
29	
30	from .errors import BackupIntegrity, ValidationError
31	from .model import identifier, positive_int
32	from .policy import parse_policy
33	
34	BACKUP_VERSION_V1 = "thresholdsafe-backup-v1"
35	BACKUP_VERSION_V2 = "thresholdsafe-backup-v2"
36	BACKUP_VERSION_V3 = "thresholdsafe-backup-v3"
37	BACKUP_VERSION = BACKUP_VERSION_V3
38	ZERO_HASH = "0" * 64
39	HEX_HASH = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
40	SHARE_VALUE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{1,132}$")
41	
42	TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS = {
43	    "backup_version",
44	    "generated_at",
45	    "secret",
46	    "shares",
47	    "approvals",
48	    "audit_events",
49	    "checksum",
50	}
51	TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS_V2 = TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS | {"authorization_policy"}
52	TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS_V3 = TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS_V2 | {"versions"}
53	SECRET_FIELDS = {
54	    "id",
55	    "name",
56	    "version",
57	    "threshold",
58	    "holders",
59	    "approvals_required",
60	    "secret_digest",
61	    "secret_length",
62	    "status",
63	    "status_reason",
64	    "status_changed_at",
65	    "status_epoch",
66	    "created_at",
67	    "updated_at",
68	}
69	SHARE_FIELDS = {
70	    "share_id",
71	    "secret_id",
72	    "version",
73	    "holder",
74	    "coordinate",
75	    "value",
76	    "commitment",
77	    "distributed_at",
78	    "invalidated_at",
79	}
80	APPROVAL_FIELDS = {"secret_id", "version", "approver", "created_at", "consumed_at"}
81	EVENT_FIELDS = {"sequence", "type", "payload", "occurred_at", "previous_hash", "hash"}
82	VERSION_ENTRY_FIELDS = {"version", "approval_mode", "holders", "approvers"}
83	APPROVAL_MODES = ("legacy", "separated")
84	
85	
86	def encode(value: Any) -> str:
87	    """Canonical JSON: sorted keys, compact separators, no ASCII escaping."""
88	    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
89	
90	
91	def share_commitment(secret_id: str, version: int, holder: str, value: str) -> str:
92	    return hashlib.sha256(
93	        f"thresholdsafe:v1:share:{secret_id}:{version}:{holder}:{value}".encode()
94	    ).hexdigest()
95	
96	
97	def event_hash(previous: str, sequence: int, event_type: str, encoded: str, occurred_at: str) -> str:
98	    return hashlib.sha256(f"{previous}|{sequence}|{event_type}|{encoded}|{occurred_at}".encode()).hexdigest()
99	
100	
101	def checksum(unsigned: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
102	    """SHA-256 of the canonical encoding of every top-level value but the checksum."""
103	    return hashlib.sha256(encode(unsigned).encode()).hexdigest()
104	
105	
106	def stamp(backup: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
107	    """Attach the checksum covering the other top-level values of a backup."""
108	    backup["checksum"] = checksum(backup)
109	    return backup
110	
111	
112	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ structure
113	def _require_object(raw: Any, fields: set[str], description: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
114	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
115	        raise ValidationError(f"{description} must be an object")
116	    missing = sorted(fields - set(raw))
117	    if missing:
118	        raise ValidationError(f"{description} is missing required fields: {', '.join(missing)}")
119	    extra = sorted(set(raw) - fields)
120	    if extra:
121	        raise ValidationError(f"{description} does not allow these fields: {', '.join(extra)}")
122	    return raw
123	
124	
125	def _non_empty_text(value: Any, field: str) -> str:
126	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
127	        raise ValidationError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
128	    return value
129	
130	
131	def _optional_text(value: Any, field: str) -> str | None:
132	    if value is not None and not isinstance(value, str):
133	        raise ValidationError(f"{field} must be a string or null")
134	    return value
135	
136	
137	def _hash_text(value: Any, field: str) -> str:
138	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not HEX_HASH.match(value):
139	        raise ValidationError(f"{field} must be a lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest")
140	    return value
141	
142	
143	def _parse_secret(raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
144	    secret = _require_object(raw, SECRET_FIELDS, "secret")
145	    identifier(secret["id"], "secret id")
146	    _non_empty_text(secret["name"], "secret name")
147	    positive_int(secret["version"], "secret version", 1)
148	    positive_int(secret["threshold"], "secret threshold", 2)
149	    positive_int(secret["approvals_required"], "secret approvals_required", 1)
150	    holders = secret["holders"]
151	    if not isinstance(holders, list) or not holders or any(not isinstance(h, str) for h in holders):
152	        raise ValidationError("secret holders must be a non-empty array of holder identifiers")
153	    if len(set(holders)) != len(holders):
154	        raise ValidationError("secret holders must not repeat the same holder")
155	    _hash_text(secret["secret_digest"], "secret_digest")
156	    positive_int(secret["secret_length"], "secret_length", 1)
157	    if secret["status"] not in ("active", "frozen"):
158	        raise ValidationError("secret status must be active or frozen")
159	    _optional_text(secret["status_reason"], "status_reason")
160	    epoch = secret["status_epoch"]
161	    if isinstance(epoch, bool) or not isinstance(epoch, int) or epoch < 0:
162	        raise ValidationError("status_epoch must be a non-negative integer")
163	    _non_empty_text(secret["status_changed_at"], "status_changed_at")
164	    _non_empty_text(secret["created_at"], "created_at")
165	    _non_empty_text(secret["updated_at"], "updated_at")
166	    return secret
167	
168	
169	def _parse_share(raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
170	    share = _require_object(raw, SHARE_FIELDS, "share")
171	    identifier(share["share_id"], "share_id", limit=250)
172	    identifier(share["secret_id"], "share secret_id")
173	    identifier(share["holder"], "share holder")
174	    positive_int(share["version"], "share version", 1)
175	    positive_int(share["coordinate"], "share coordinate", 1)
176	    value = share["value"]
177	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not SHARE_VALUE.match(value):
178	        raise ValidationError("share value must be lowercase hexadecimal of at most 132 characters")
179	    _hash_text(share["commitment"], "share commitment")
180	    _optional_text(share["distributed_at"], "distributed_at")
181	    _optional_text(share["invalidated_at"], "invalidated_at")
182	    return share
183	
184	
185	def _parse_approval(raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
186	    approval = _require_object(raw, APPROVAL_FIELDS, "approval")
187	    identifier(approval["secret_id"], "approval secret_id")
188	    identifier(approval["approver"], "approver")
189	    positive_int(approval["version"], "approval version", 1)
190	    _non_empty_text(approval["created_at"], "created_at")
191	    _optional_text(approval["consumed_at"], "consumed_at")
192	    return approval
193	
194	
195	def _parse_event(raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
196	    event = _require_object(raw, EVENT_FIELDS, "audit event")
197	    positive_int(event["sequence"], "event sequence", 1)
198	    _non_empty_text(event["type"], "event type")
199	    if not isinstance(event["payload"], dict):
200	        raise ValidationError("event payload must be an object")
201	    _non_empty_text(event["occurred_at"], "occurred_at")
202	    _hash_text(event["previous_hash"], "event previous_hash")
203	    _hash_text(event["hash"], "event hash")
204	    return event
205	
206	
207	def _parse_version_entry(raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
208	    entry = _require_object(raw, VERSION_ENTRY_FIELDS, "versions entry")
209	    positive_int(entry["version"], "versions entry version", 1)
210	    if entry["approval_mode"] not in APPROVAL_MODES:
211	        raise ValidationError("versions entry approval_mode must be legacy or separated")
212	    for field in ("holders", "approvers"):
213	        values = entry[field]
214	        if not isinstance(values, list) or not values:
215	            raise ValidationError(f"versions entry {field} must be a non-empty array of identifiers")
216	        for value in values:
217	            identifier(value, f"versions entry {field} entry")
218	        if len(set(values)) != len(values):
219	            raise ValidationError(f"versions entry {field} must not repeat the same identifier")
220	    return entry
221	
222	
223	def _parse(backup: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
224	    if not isinstance(backup, dict):
225	        raise ValidationError("backup must be an object")
226	    version = backup.get("backup_version")
227	    if version == BACKUP_VERSION_V1:
228	        fields = TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS
229	    elif version == BACKUP_VERSION_V2:
230	        fields = TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS_V2
231	    elif version == BACKUP_VERSION_V3:
232	        fields = TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS_V3
233	    else:
234	        raise ValidationError(
235	            f"backup_version must be {BACKUP_VERSION_V1}, {BACKUP_VERSION_V2} or {BACKUP_VERSION_V3}"
236	        )
237	    document = _require_object(backup, fields, "backup")
238	    _non_empty_text(document["generated_at"], "generated_at")
239	    _hash_text(document["checksum"], "checksum")
240	    if version in (BACKUP_VERSION_V2, BACKUP_VERSION_V3) and document["authorization_policy"] is not None:
241	        parse_policy(document["authorization_policy"])
242	    shares = document["shares"]
243	    if not isinstance(shares, list):
244	        raise ValidationError("shares must be an array")
245	    approvals = document["approvals"]
246	    if not isinstance(approvals, list):
247	        raise ValidationError("approvals must be an array")
248	    events = document["audit_events"]
249	    if not isinstance(events, list):
250	        raise ValidationError("audit_events must be an array")
251	    versions: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None
252	    if version == BACKUP_VERSION_V3:
253	        entries = document["versions"]
254	        if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
255	            raise ValidationError("versions must be a non-empty array")
256	        versions = [_parse_version_entry(entry) for entry in entries]
257	    return {
258	        "raw": document,
259	        "secret": _parse_secret(document["secret"]),
260	        "versions": versions,
261	        "shares": [_parse_share(entry) for entry in shares],
262	        "approvals": [_parse_approval(entry) for entry in approvals],
263	        "audit_events": [_parse_event(entry) for entry in events],
264	    }
265	
266	
267	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ integrity
268	def _check_integrity(parsed: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
269	    raw = parsed["raw"]
270	    unsigned = {key: value for key, value in raw.items() if key != "checksum"}
271	    if raw["checksum"] != checksum(unsigned):
272	        raise BackupIntegrity("checksum does not match the backup contents")
273	
274	    secret = parsed["secret"]
275	    secret_id = secret["id"]
276	    current = secret["version"]
277	    shares = parsed["shares"]
278	    for share in shares:
279	        if share["secret_id"] != secret_id:
280	            raise BackupIntegrity(f"share {share['share_id']} does not belong to secret {secret_id}")
281	        if share["share_id"] != f"{secret_id}.v{share['version']}.{share['holder']}":
282	            raise BackupIntegrity(
283	                f"share {share['share_id']} does not match its secret, version and holder"
284	            )
285	        expected = share_commitment(secret_id, share["version"], share["holder"], share["value"])
286	        if share["commitment"] != expected:
287	            raise BackupIntegrity(f"share {share['share_id']} value does not match its commitment")
288	
289	    if {share["version"] for share in shares} != set(range(1, current + 1)):
290	        raise BackupIntegrity("shares do not cover every version from 1 to the current version")
291	    roster: dict[int, set[str]] = {}
292	    for share in shares:
293	        roster.setdefault(share["version"], set()).add(share["holder"])
294	
295	    # Role attribution: a v3 document pins the holder and approver rosters of
296	    # every version; v1/v2 documents are read in legacy mode, where the
297	    # approvers of a version are exactly its holders.
298	    versions = parsed["versions"]
299	    if versions is not None:
300	        if [entry["version"] for entry in versions] != list(range(1, current + 1)):
301	            raise BackupIntegrity("versions do not cover every version from 1 to the current version")
302	        approver_roster: dict[int, set[str]] = {}
303	        for entry in versions:
304	            holders = set(entry["holders"])
305	            approvers = set(entry["approvers"])
306	            if holders != roster[entry["version"]]:
307	                raise BackupIntegrity(
308	                    f"version {entry['version']} holders do not match the shares issued for it"
309	                )
310	            if entry["approval_mode"] == "legacy":
311	                if approvers != holders:
312	                    raise BackupIntegrity(
313	                        f"version {entry['version']} is legacy but its approvers differ from its holders"
314	                    )
315	            elif holders & approvers:
316	                raise BackupIntegrity(
317	                    f"version {entry['version']} approvers overlap its holders"
318	                )
319	            approver_roster[entry["version"]] = approvers
320	    else:
321	        approver_roster = roster
322	
323	    for approval in parsed["approvals"]:
324	        if approval["secret_id"] != secret_id:
325	            raise BackupIntegrity(f"approval by {approval['approver']} does not belong to secret {secret_id}")
326	        if not 1 <= approval["version"] <= current:
327	            raise BackupIntegrity(
328	                f"approval by {approval['approver']} targets a version outside 1..{current}"
329	            )
330	        if approval["approver"] not in approver_roster[approval["version"]]:
331	            raise BackupIntegrity(
332	                f"approver {approval['approver']} is not an approver of version {approval['version']}"
333	            )
334	
335	    previous = ZERO_HASH
336	    for index, event in enumerate(parsed["audit_events"], start=1):
337	        if event["sequence"] != index:
338	            raise BackupIntegrity("audit events are not an unbroken sequence starting at 1")
339	        expected = event_hash(
340	            event["previous_hash"], event["sequence"], event["type"],
341	            encode(event["payload"]), event["occurred_at"],
342	        )
343	        if event["previous_hash"] != previous or event["hash"] != expected:
344	            raise BackupIntegrity("audit chain hashes do not match the recorded events")
345	        previous = event["hash"]
346	
347	
348	def verify(backup: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
349	    """Validate a backup document and return a summary of its contents.
350	
351	    Pure: nothing is read from or written to any service state, and the
352	    document is either accepted as a whole or rejected as a whole.
353	    """
354	    parsed = _parse(backup)
355	    _check_integrity(parsed)
356	    secret = parsed["secret"]
357	    return {
358	        "valid": True,
359	        "secret_id": secret["id"],
360	        "version": secret["version"],
361	        "share_count": len(parsed["shares"]),
362	        "approval_count": len(parsed["approvals"]),
363	        "event_count": len(parsed["audit_events"]),
364	    }

11	SCHEMA = """
12	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS secrets (
13	  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
14	  document TEXT NOT NULL,
15	  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
16	  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
17	);
18	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shares (
19	  share_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
20	  secret_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES secrets(id),
21	  version INTEGER NOT NULL,
22	  holder TEXT NOT NULL,
23	  coordinate INTEGER NOT NULL,
24	  value TEXT NOT NULL,
25	  commitment TEXT NOT NULL,
26	  distributed_at TEXT,
27	  invalidated_at TEXT,
28	  UNIQUE (secret_id, version, holder)
29	);
30	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approvals (
31	  secret_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES secrets(id),
32	  version INTEGER NOT NULL,
33	  approver TEXT NOT NULL,
34	  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
35	  consumed_at TEXT,
36	  PRIMARY KEY (secret_id, version, approver)
37	);
38	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_events (
39	  secret_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES secrets(id),
40	  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
41	  type TEXT NOT NULL,
42	  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
43	  occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
44	  previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
45	  hash TEXT NOT NULL,
46	  PRIMARY KEY (secret_id, sequence)
47	);
48	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency (
49	  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
50	  operation TEXT NOT NULL,
51	  response TEXT NOT NULL
52	);
53	"""
54	
55	
56	class Store:
57	    def __init__(self, path: str):
58	        Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
59	        self.path = path
60	        self._local = threading.local()
61	        # Create the schema eagerly so the file is fully initialised even when
62	        # worker threads later open their own connections.
63	        self._open()
64	
65	    def _open(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
66	        connection = sqlite3.connect(self.path, isolation_level=None, timeout=10)
67	        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
68	        connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
69	        connection.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 10000")
70	        connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
71	        connection.executescript(SCHEMA)
72	        self._local.connection = connection
73	        return connection
74	
75	    @property
76	    def connection(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
77	        connection = getattr(self._local, "connection", None)
78	        if connection is None:
79	            connection = self._open()
80	        return connection
81	
82	    @contextmanager
83	    def transaction(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
84	        connection = self.connection
85	        connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
86	        try:
87	            yield connection
88	        except Exception:
89	            connection.execute("ROLLBACK")
90	            raise
91	        else:
92	            connection.execute("COMMIT")
93	
94	    @staticmethod
95	    def encode(value: Any) -> str:
96	        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
97	
98	    @staticmethod
99	    def decode(value: str) -> Any:
100	        return json.loads(value)
101	
102	    @staticmethod
103	    def now() -> str:
104	        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
